classification_notes.direction: Repo ±5bp neutral band: open +6.98bp is up; close -3.25bp is flat.
classification_notes.scenario: Repo metrics.py: strict >+50bp bull, <-50bp bear, otherwise base.
classification_notes.regime: Manual OHLC plus dated reporting; high stayed below 50,000, low reached -51.19bp, close recovered to -3.25bp. No fixed classifier or minute VWAP series.
classification_notes.breadth: Operational classification by official TWSE stock counts: 588 up vs 387 down = up. Repo lacks a frozen neutral-band formula, so breadth accuracy is provisional.
classification_notes.brier: Mean squared multiclass Brier score per repo.

market_view.note: The market opened slightly higher, failed below 50,000 and finished near flat after a wide intraday range. This matches the high-level consolidation thesis.

open_hypothesis.note: Forecast +8bp versus realized +6.98bp; direction hit and magnitude error only 1.02bp.

intraday_hypothesis.note: The index tested 50,000 but peaked at 49,966.89, then fell to 49,567.52 and recovered near flat. Intraday range 80.16bp was much larger than the close move.

close_hypothesis.note: Base ±50bp outcome was correct, but predicted up/+15bp versus realized flat/-3.25bp; close direction missed and magnitude error was 18.25bp.

breadth_hypothesis.note: Official listed-stock breadth was positive, 588 advancers versus 387 decliners, while the forecast was flat/concentrated.

bull_script.note: The index did not accept 50,000 and the close return did not reach +50bp.

base_script.note: Small positive open, repeated 50,000 rejection, sector rotation and a close within ±50bp all occurred. Breadth was stronger than described.

bear_script.note: The index traded below the prior close and reached -51.19bp intraday, but breadth was positive and the close recovered to the Base band.

key_driver_evaluation.note: Night-session weakness supported low gap conviction; realized cash gap was only +6.98bp.
Positive overseas setting supported the open, but it did not produce a positive close.
Taiwan semiconductor mapping was weak: official semiconductor -0.23%, electronics -0.45%, TSMC closed flat.
The 50,000 barrier remained effective; daily high was 49,966.89.
Index-versus-cross-section separation was relevant, but breadth reversed to positive while large electronics lagged.
No reproducible evidence in collected sources that an RBI surprise drove Taiwan intraday direction; FOMC minutes remained outside the cash session.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.condition: 09:15–09:30有效突破並站穩50,000，且四層廣度同步擴張，Base range假設失效並轉Bull。
invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: High remained below 50,000; no acceptance above the level.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.condition: 台積電與核心權值跌破opening range/VWAP、指數失守前收49,822.55且下跌家數擴張，轉Bear。
invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: Index fell below prior close and large electronics weakened, but official closing breadth was positive and final Bear outcome did not occur; VWAP conjunction is unverified.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.condition: RBI決議相對市場預期出現顯著surprise並在台股交易時段引發跨市場同步反應。
invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: No verified cross-market RBI surprise effect in the collected evidence.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.condition: 08:50後的新事件不得回寫本快照，只能納入事後誤差歸因。
invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: Prediction snapshot stayed unchanged; post-cutoff data were used only in evaluation.

error_attribution.data: Minute VWAP/opening-range evidence, intraday breadth path and TPEx breadth were not captured; official close data are complete.
error_attribution.inference: The model correctly selected Base/range but converted a small positive prior into an up-close class instead of flat.
error_attribution.weight: It underweighted non-electronic and mid/small-cap rotation versus weak large electronics.
error_attribution.magnitude: Open error 1.02bp; close forecast overestimated realized return by 18.25bp.

actual_driver_attribution.claim: 50,000 resistance and large-electronics weakness constrained the weighted index.
actual_driver_attribution.causal_status: Strong descriptive alignment; exact causal contribution unavailable.

actual_driver_attribution.claim: Rotation into non-electronics and broader stocks supported positive breadth.
actual_driver_attribution.evidence: Ex-financial/electronics +2.39%, financial +1.02%, MidCap 100 +0.65%, SmallCap 300 +0.92%; official breadth 588 up vs 387 down.

source_conflicts.resolution: Use official TWSE stock column; news universe is not identical/fully specified.

proposed_model_changes.proposal: Keep the night-session/ADR divergence rule; today's +8bp gap estimate was accurate.
Add a stronger flat-close prior when the expected return is near the ±5bp classification boundary and 50,000 resistance remains active.
Model weighted-index direction and equal-weight breadth independently with large-electronics versus non-electronic rotation features.
Freeze a quantitative breadth-neutral threshold before future forecasts so breadth hits are reproducible.

model_change_gate.reason: One formal day supports retaining the gap rule, but close/breadth changes require repeated frozen-sample evidence or walk-forward improvement.

limitations: No intraday breadth path or TPEx breadth; closing TWSE stock counts used.
Calibration error and baseline lift require multiple eligible days.
